description: As a team member I want to create a work item with a title and an optional description so that I can track tasks

acceptance_criteria.description: Title is required and cannot be empty

description: As a team member I want to list all work items so that I can see the current tasks

acceptance_criteria.description: All work items are returned in the response
Response includes title, description, and status

description: As a team member I want to mark a work item as done so that I can track completion time

acceptance_criteria.description: Completion time is recorded when marked as done

description: As a team member I want to delete a work item so that I can remove completed tasks

acceptance_criteria.description: Work item is removed from the system
Deletion is confirmed with a response
